Specification: This specification tests the fingerprinting of sets in TLA+ by assigning various set and function values to variables and observing their behavior under TLC. The variables x, y, z, and w are assigned sets, sets of sets, records, and sets of functions, respectively. The Init operator initializes these variables with specific values, and the Next operator allows x to be updated to a set with repeated elements, while the other variables remain unchanged. The spec includes an invariant Inv that asserts the variables retain their initial values. The comments and Print statements indicate the purpose is to check that TLC recognizes only one distinct state despite syntactic differences in set representations. No fault model is present, and the properties focus on state equality and set semantics.
StringLiterals: Should find only one distinct state
